article.title: Microsoft: China’s Salt Typhoon hackers are using Artex
article.summary: An AI tool implicated in several high-profile breaches is rapidly being integrated into the hacking suites of groups from China and North Korea, Microsoft said.

article.title: Bots exploited leaked AWS key from Docker image in under 8 seconds
article.summary: A cloud access key left inside a newly published Docker image can be found and used by bots in less than eight seconds, Billy Tsouvalas and Nick Nikiforakis of Stony Brook University discovered after planting 300 decoy images on public container registries.
